grade.rationale: The candidate fully matches the reference: the 2026 change from API keys to OAuth 2.1 (elm-auth-2026), the current OAuth 2.1 requirement, and the 2025 API-key validity preserved as historical/superseded (elm-auth-2025), honoring the prohibited merge by not rewriting the 2025 claim as false. Both snapshots share subject_id/lineage_id and are correctly treated as one subject over time, so no false merge; superseded evidence is clearly marked historical, so no stale-current leak; and the historical claim is retained, so no lost history. Every factual claim traces to a cited snapshot or to verifiable source metadata, so unsupported_claims is 0. The sole defect is the unresolved list: the reference specifies no unresolved items, and the candidate invented four peripheral questions (exact effective date, grace periods, OAuth implementation details, post-2026 evidence bounds), which earns no credit and slightly dilutes auditability, hence unresolved_accuracy 0 and usefulness 90.
